name: TX-37
label: Safe D

key_factors: No polling or expert ratings available
model.rationale: TX-37's D+30 lean and Casar's overwhelming financial advantage make a Democratic hold the clear expectation, and Polymarket prices the race near certain for Democrats. With no polls or expert ratings, the forecast rests on fundamentals, which point to a Safe D outcome.
model.watch: Any late polling showing a much tighter race or a surge of outside spending against Casar would warrant revisiting the margin.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Austin-based TX-37 is one of the most Democratic-leaning House districts in Texas, with a partisan lean of D+30. Incumbent Greg Casar is running for reelection and holds a commanding financial position, having raised about $1.17 million with nearly $600,000 on hand, while Republican Lauren Peña has raised roughly $118,000 and reports minimal cash. No outside groups are spending against Casar.

No public general-election polls or expert ratings are available for this race, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals and the fundraising gap. Prediction markets give Democrats roughly a 98% chance of holding the seat, consistent with a Safe D assessment.
